% Known-good page-break form: the workspace rides INSIDE each problem's
% unbreakable minipage as \vspace*, so a page break can neither discard the
% glue nor separate the stem from its writing room.
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{prob}
\newcommand{\problem}[1]{\stepcounter{prob}\noindent\textbf{\theprob.}\quad #1}
\begin{document}
\noindent\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
\problem{Solve for $x$: $2x + 3 = 11$.}
\par\vspace*{5cm}
\end{minipage}\par
\noindent\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
\problem{Solve for $x$: $x^2 - 9 = 0$.}
\par\vspace*{5cm}
\end{minipage}\par
\end{document}
